scenarios.title: Display Complete Inventory Page Layout
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure users can access all inventory page components for product browsing
preconditions: User is successfully authenticated and logged in
steps: Navigate to the inventory page
Verify header displays application logo, hamburger menu, shopping cart icon, and cart badge
Verify product sort dropdown is visible with sorting options
Verify inventory list displays all available products
Verify footer displays footer information and social media links
scenarios.expected_result: Complete inventory page layout is displayed with all required components visible and functional

scenarios.title: Verify All Six Inventory Products Display
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure complete product catalog is available for customer selection
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
steps: Count the number of inventory products displayed
Verify each product card contains product image, name, description, price, and Add to Cart button
scenarios.expected_result: Exactly six inventory products are displayed with complete product information on each card

traceability.section: SC-M02-002: Verify All Inventory Items are Displayed

scenarios.title: Add Single Product to Shopping Cart
scenarios.business_objective: Enable customers to select products for purchase
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Cart is empty or contains other items
Target product is not already in cart
steps: Click the Add to Cart button on a specific product
Verify the button changes to Remove
Verify the cart badge increments by one
scenarios.expected_result: Product is added to cart, button changes to Remove, and cart badge shows updated count

traceability.section: SC-M02-003: Add Single Item to Cart
SC-M02-003: Add Single Item to Cart

scenarios.title: Remove Product from Shopping Cart
scenarios.business_objective: Allow customers to modify their cart by removing unwanted items
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
At least one product is already in the cart
Target product shows Remove button
steps: Click the Remove button on a product that is in the cart
Verify the button changes back to Add to Cart
Verify the cart badge decreases by one
scenarios.expected_result: Product is removed from cart, button changes to Add to Cart, and cart badge shows decreased count

scenarios.title: Sort Products by Name Alphabetically
scenarios.business_objective: Help customers find products easily by alphabetical organization
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Products are displayed in default order
steps: Click on the product sort dropdown
Select Name (A to Z) option
Verify products are rearranged in alphabetical order by name
scenarios.expected_result: Products are displayed in alphabetical order from A to Z by product name

scenarios.title: Sort Products by Name Reverse Alphabetically
scenarios.business_objective: Provide alternative product organization for customer convenience
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Products are displayed in any current order
steps: Click on the product sort dropdown
Select Name (Z to A) option
Verify products are rearranged in reverse alphabetical order by name
scenarios.expected_result: Products are displayed in reverse alphabetical order from Z to A by product name

scenarios.title: Sort Products by Price Low to High
scenarios.business_objective: Enable price-conscious customers to find affordable options first
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Products are displayed in any current order
steps: Click on the product sort dropdown
Select Price (low to high) option
Verify products are rearranged in ascending price order
scenarios.expected_result: Products are displayed with lowest priced items first, ascending to highest priced items

traceability.section: SC-M02-008: Sort Products by Price (Low to High)

scenarios.title: Sort Products by Price High to Low
scenarios.business_objective: Allow customers to view premium products first
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Products are displayed in any current order
steps: Click on the product sort dropdown
Select Price (high to low) option
Verify products are rearranged in descending price order
scenarios.expected_result: Products are displayed with highest priced items first, descending to lowest priced items

traceability.section: SC-M02-009: Sort Products by Price (High to Low)

scenarios.title: Navigate to Product Details Page
scenarios.business_objective: Provide customers with detailed product information for informed purchasing decisions
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Products are displayed with clickable images and titles
steps: Click on a product image or product title
Verify navigation occurs to the Product Details page for the selected product
scenarios.expected_result: User is navigated to the Product Details page showing detailed information for the selected product

scenarios.title: Access Shopping Cart Page
scenarios.business_objective: Allow customers to review and manage their selected items
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Shopping cart icon is visible in the header
steps: Click on the shopping cart icon
Verify navigation occurs to the shopping cart page
scenarios.expected_result: User is navigated to the shopping cart page displaying current cart contents

scenarios.title: Open Navigation Menu
scenarios.business_objective: Provide users access to application navigation options
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
Hamburger menu icon is visible in the header
steps: Click on the hamburger menu icon
Verify the sidebar menu opens with navigation options
scenarios.expected_result: Sidebar menu opens displaying available navigation options

scenarios.title: Logout and Return to Login Page
scenarios.business_objective: Securely terminate user session and redirect to authentication
preconditions: User is logged in and on the inventory page
Hamburger menu is accessible
steps: Click on the hamburger menu icon to open sidebar menu
Click on the Logout option
Verify redirection to the Login page occurs
scenarios.expected_result: User session is terminated and user is redirected to the Login page

scenarios.title: Maintain Cart Contents After Page Refresh
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure cart persistence during user session for improved shopping experience
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
One or more items have been added to the cart
Cart badge shows current item count
steps: Note the current cart contents and badge count
Refresh the browser page
Verify cart selections and badge count remain unchanged
scenarios.expected_result: Cart contents and badge count are preserved after page refresh
